title.zh: Republicans Post Final CLARITY Act Text With Trump-Backed Ethics Terms a Day Before Cloture Vote
title.en: Republicans Post Final CLARITY Act Text With Trump-Backed Ethics Terms a Day Before Cloture Vote

current_state.zh: 参议院未能推进CLARITY Act，终结辩论投票以49-50失败，该法案在2026年的前景基本结束；市场反应为比特币ETF大幅净流出，但法案后续仍可能通过其他立法或SEC/CFTC规则制定推进。
current_state.en: The Senate failed to advance the CLARITY Act after a 49-50 cloture vote, effectively ending its chances in 2026; the market reaction included sharp Bitcoin ETF outflows, though the bill could still be revived or addressed via SEC/CFTC rulemaking.

updates.title_zh: Republicans Post Final CLARITY Act Text With Trump-Backed Ethics Terms a Day Before Cloture Vote
updates.title_en: Republicans Post Final CLARITY Act Text With Trump-Backed Ethics Terms a Day Before Cloture Vote
updates.what_changed_zh: Republicans released the final CLARITY Act text, revising ethics terms by removing the January 20, 2029 sunset, reversing the July bar on state attorney general enforcement, and raising civil penalties to 20% of the take or $500,000, whichever is greater, ahead of a Senate cloture vote.

updates.title_zh: Bitcoin ETFs Had Their Worst Day Since June Following Failed Clarity Act Vote
updates.title_en: Bitcoin ETFs Had Their Worst Day Since June Following Failed Clarity Act Vote
updates.what_changed_zh: 参议院以49-50未能通过CLARITY Act的终结辩论投票，该法案在2026年实际上已无望推进；同日美国现货比特币ETF录得4.504亿美元净流出，为6月24日以来最大单日流出。
updates.what_changed_en: The Senate failed to invoke cloture on the CLARITY Act by a 49-50 vote, effectively ending its chances in 2026; the same day U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs saw $450.4 million in net outflows, their worst day since June 24.
updates.current_state_zh: 参议院未能推进CLARITY Act，终结辩论投票以49-50失败，该法案在2026年的前景基本结束；市场反应为比特币ETF大幅净流出，但法案后续仍可能通过其他立法或SEC/CFTC规则制定推进。

updates.detailed_summary_zh: U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs saw $450.4 million in net outflows—their worst day since June 24—after the Senate failed to advance the Clarity Act crypto market-structure bill in a 49-50 cloture vote.
updates.detailed_summary_en: U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs saw $450.4 million in net outflows—their worst day since June 24—after the Senate failed to advance the Clarity Act crypto market-structure bill in a 49-50 cloture vote.
